## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home emotional on the last day of school as Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) makes his farewell speech to the students. Soon after, the community welcomes a new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his young wife, who quickly become beloved in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) make elaborate preparations at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to host the Allans for tea, but when Anne's proudly baked layer cake is finally served, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) tastes something terribly wrong with it.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decorates the tea table beautifully to impress the minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife. However, when Mrs. Allan tries Anne's specially made layer cake, it turns out to be flavored with anodyne liniment instead of vanilla. Mortified, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) flees to her room, but Mrs. Allan kindly comforts her and invites her to show off her flower garden.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home thrilled to receive an invitation to tea at the manse from Mrs. Allan. Despite her fears of rain and improper etiquette, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys a wonderful afternoon at the manse with Mrs. Allan and another girl, [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md). She returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in high spirits, recounting her evening to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and sharing news of the new female schoolteacher, Miss Muriel [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a Christmas gift of elegant slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). Later, after the successful [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) concert where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stars in her recitations, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk home discussing the evening's triumphs and gossip. Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) sit by the kitchen fire and express pride in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), beginning to contemplate her future education.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

> As life in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) settles back into a routine after the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) turns thirteen and walks along [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), discussing her birthday, a fictional story she wrote, and the idea of forming a story club. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) explains the newly formed story club to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who scoffs at the endeavor as a foolish waste of time while reminding [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to focus on her chores.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on her silent rivalry and unresolved feelings toward Gilbert as the school term comes to a close. Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) reassures the class that she will return next year to guide them through the Queen's entrance preparation. After school ends, Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), discussing Matthew's health with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and praising Anne's growth and maturity over the years.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) completes her term at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school and travels to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations, writing to [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) about her nerve-wracking experience. After three agonizing weeks of waiting back home at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings the published pass list showing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the Island. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the joyful news with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and ends her night with a thankful prayer for her future.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) before driving to the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) with [Billy](../character/billy.md) and Jane for a charity concert. At the event, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) suffers from severe stage fright upon facing the elegant audience and seeing professional performers. However, after spotting [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the crowd, she finds her resolve, performs wonderfully, receives an encore, and enjoys a triumphant evening.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns she won the Avery scholarship while [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal, bringing pride to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) during Commencement. Returning home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the summer, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) catches up with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), learns of Gilbert's plans to teach, and notices the deteriorating health of both [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) as well as rumors about their bank. After a restful day revisiting her favorite spots, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares a touching conversation with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), who tells her how proud he is of her before a turning point in her life.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream
